# Motivation
This PR clarifies which APIs should be delegated to device-specific modules and explains the rationale behind those decisions. It also serves as guidance for backend developers on how to integrate functionality with `torch.accelerator`, while providing users with the motivation, design principles, and intended usage of these APIs.
